##My rcode to create the positions for FOVs

```{r}
slidename <- "NLS42058_NLTMA332"

transcript_summary <- aggregate(nCount_RNA ~ fov, data = metadata, FUN = mean)
colnames(transcript_summary) <- c("FOV", "mean_transcript")

fov_pos2 <- merge(fov_pos, transcript_summary, by = "FOV", all.x = TRUE)
```

```{r qc_controls_and_filtering}
# Compute per-cell QC metrics
HCC <- computeFOVintegrity(HCC, max_prop_loss = FOV_MAX_PROP_LOSS, panel_name = PANEL_FOV)
HCC <- computeSBR(HCC)
```

After adjustments of threshold values ... the filtering can be applied on the Seurat object
using custom function QCfiltering...

```{r compute_filtering}

# Apply QC filtering
HCC_qc <- QCfiltering(
  HCC,
  count_min               = COUNTS_THRESHOLD_MIN,
  count_max               = COUNTS_THRESHOLD_MAX,
  area_min                = AREA_THRESHOLD_MIN,
  area_max                = AREA_THRESHOLD_MAX,
  fov_integrity_threshold = FOV_INTEGRITY_PERCENT_THRESHOLD,
  sbr_min                 = SBR_THRESHOLD_MIN,
  sbr_max                 = SBR_THRESHOLD_MAX,
  split_ratio_min         = SPLIT_RATIO_THRESHOLD_MIN,
  split_ratio_max         = SPLIT_RATIO_THRESHOLD_MAX)

```

## 5. Dimensionality Reduction

Four embedding strategies are compared to find the best representation for downstream clustering. Batch effects across samples are addressed progressively.

### 5.1 SCTransform — No Batch Correction

Baseline embedding using SCT normalisation, PCA, and UMAP. Exposes any sample-level batch structure.

```{r dimensionality_reduction_noBatch_correction}

requireNamespace("glmGamPoi", quietly = TRUE)

HCC_qc <- SCTransform(
  HCC_qc,
  assay           = "RNA",
  vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA"),
  clip.range      = c(-10, 10)
)

HCC_qc <- RunPCA(HCC_qc, npcs = 30, assay = "SCT")
ElbowPlot(HCC_qc, ndims = 30)
NPCS <- 20

HCC_qc <- RunUMAP(HCC_qc, dims = 1:NPCS, reduction = "pca")
UMAP.plot0 <- DimPlot(HCC_qc, group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE, reduction = "umap") +
  ggtitle("UMAP — SCT, res 0.5")
UMAP.plot0

HCC_qc <- FindNeighbors(HCC_qc, dims = 1:20, verbose = FALSE)

##run clustree
# Define your range of resolutions
res_range <- seq(0.1, 1.0, by = 0.2)

# Run FindClusters for each resolution
for (res in res_range) {
  HCC_qc <- FindClusters(HCC_qc, resolution = res)
}

clustree(HCC_qc, prefix = "RNA_snn_res.")

HCC_qc <- FindClusters(HCC_qc,resolution = 0.5,  verbose = FALSE)
p <- DimPlot(HCC_qc, group.by = "sample_id", reduction = "umap", ncol = 1, pt.size = 0.4, label = TRUE, raster = FALSE,
             cols = hue_pal(l = 55, c = 100)(30)) +
  ggtitle("UMAP — SCT, By sample_id")
p

ggplot2::ggsave("/scratch/users/elihash/hcc_tma_project/output/umap_by_sample.pdf", p, width = 24, height = 20, dpi = 300, limitsize = FALSE)

``` 


A clear sample-level batch effect is visible in the UMAP.

### 5.2 SCTransform + Harmony Batch Correction

Harmony integration applied on the SCT PCA embedding to correct sample-level batch.

```{r DR_with_harmony_batch_correction}
tmp_00 <- HCC_qc[["pca"]]
harmony_embedding1 <- harmony::RunHarmony(
  HCC_qc[["pca"]]@cell.embeddings,
  meta_data = HCC_qc@meta.data,
  vars_use  = "sample_id")
tmp_00@cell.embeddings  <- harmony_embedding1
HCC_qc[["pca_harmony"]] <- tmp_00

HCC_qc[["umap_sct_harmony"]] <- (RunUMAP(HCC_qc, reduction = "pca_harmony", dims = 1:NPCS))@reductions$umap
UMAP.plot1 <- DimPlot(HCC_qc, group.by = "sample_id", label = TRUE, reduction = "umap_sct_harmony", pt.size = 1.5) +
  ggtitle("UMAP — SCT + Harmony batch correction")
UMAP.plot1
```

A residual "globe" artefact in the UMAP suggests SCT normalisation is sub-optimal for this dataset. The quasi-Poisson approach below addresses this.

### 5.3 scPearsonPCA — Native Batch Integration

Quasi-Poisson PCA with built-in per-batch gene-frequency correction. More statistically appropriate for count-based spatial data.

```{r scPearson_approach_with_batch_integration}
DefaultAssay(HCC_qc) <- "RNA"

tc <- Matrix::colSums(HCC[["RNA"]]$counts)
hvgs   <- VariableFeatures(HCC_qc)

genefreq_batch <- gene_frequency(
  HCC_qc[["RNA"]]$counts,
  obs            = data.table(HCC_qc@meta.data)[, .(cell_ID, sample_id)],
  cellid_colname = "cell_ID",
  batch_variable = "sample_id")

tmp_00 <- sparse_quasipoisson_pca_seurat_batch(
  HCC_qc[["RNA"]]$counts[hvgs, ],
  totalcounts    = tc,
  grate          = genefreq_batch[hvgs, ],
  obs            = data.table(HCC_qc@meta.data)[, .(cell_ID, sample_id)],
  batch_variable = "sample_id",
  cellid_colname = "cell_ID",
  scale.max      = 10,
  do.scale       = TRUE,
  do.center      = TRUE)

HCC_qc[["pearson_pca_batch"]] <- tmp_00$reduction.data

tmp_01 <- scPearsonPCA::make_umap(tmp_00)
HCC_qc[["pearson_umap_batch"]]  <- tmp_01$ump
HCC_qc[["pearson_graph_batch"]] <- Seurat::as.Graph(tmp_01$grph)


HCC <- Seurat::FindClusters(HCC, graph = "pearson_graph_batch", leiden_method = "leidenbase", algorithm = 4, resolution = 0.5)
HCC@meta.data$pearson_clusters_batch <- HCC@meta.data$seurat_clusters
umapplotbatch <- scPearsonPCA::plot_umap(umapreduc = "pearson_umap_batch", clustercol = "pearson_clusters_batch", semuse = HCC)
print(umapplotbatch)

UMAP.plot2 <- DimPlot(HCC_qc, reduction = "pearson_umap_batch", pt.size = 1.5) +
  ggtitle("UMAP — scPearsonPCA, without harmony")
UMAP.plot2
```

### 5.4 scPearsonPCA + Harmony Batch Correction

Quasi-Poisson PCA followed by Harmony correction as an additional comparison.

```{r scPearson_approach_with_harmony_batch_on_pearson_pca}
DefaultAssay(HCC_qc) <- "RNA"

tc       <- Matrix::colSums(HCC_qc[["RNA"]]$counts)
genefreq <- scPearsonPCA::gene_frequency(HCC_qc[["RNA"]]$counts)

HCC_qc <- Seurat::FindVariableFeatures(HCC_qc, nfeatures = 2000)
hvgs   <- VariableFeatures(HCC_qc)

tmp_02 <- sparse_quasipoisson_pca_seurat(
  HCC_qc[["RNA"]]$counts[hvgs, ],
  totalcounts = tc,
  grate       = genefreq[hvgs],
  scale.max   = 10,
  do.scale    = TRUE,
  do.center   = TRUE)

harmony_embedding2 <- harmony::RunHarmony(
  tmp_02$reduction.data@cell.embeddings,
  meta_data = HCC_qc@meta.data,
  vars_use  = "sample_id")
tmp_02$reduction.data@cell.embeddings <- harmony_embedding2

tmp_03 <- scPearsonPCA::make_umap(tmp_02)
HCC_qc[["pearson_pca_harmony"]] <- tmp_02$reduction.data

HCC_qc[["pearson_umap_sct_harmony"]] <- (RunUMAP(HCC_qc, reduction = "pearson_pca_harmony", dims = 1:13))@reductions$umap
UMAP.plot3 <- DimPlot(HCC_qc, group.by = "sample_id", label = TRUE, reduction = "pearson_umap_sct_harmony", pt.size = 1.5) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  ggtitle("UMAP — scPearsonPCA + Harmony batch correction")
UMAP.plot3
```

## 6. Clustering & Cell-Type Annotation

### 6.1 Marker Discovery

Find top differentially expressed markers per cluster, then inspect cluster-level average expression with a heatmap.

```{r marker_discovery}
Idents(HCC_qc) <- HCC_qc$seurat_clusters
HCC.markers <- data.table(FindAllMarkers(HCC_qc, assay = "SCT", only.pos = TRUE))
HCC.markers

top5.markers <- (HCC.markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_head(n = 30)) %>% data.table()

avg.mat <- data.frame(AverageExpression(
  HCC_qc[top5.markers$gene, ],
  group.by = "seurat_clusters",
  layer    = "counts")[["SCT"]])
pheatmap::pheatmap(avg.mat, scale = "row", display_numbers = TRUE)
```

### 6.2 Cell-Type Annotation

Project known liver cell-type marker panels onto the UMAP to guide cluster labelling.

```{r feature_plots_cell_types}
jci_insight_markers <- list(
  "Kupffer_cells/Macrophages"     = c("C1QC", "C1QB", "C1QA", "MARCO"),
  "Hepatocytes"                   = c("SLC27A5", "ADH4", "SLC2A2", "ARG1", "CYP4A11"),
  "HSCs"                          = c("COL1A1", "COL3A1", "DCN", "TAGLN", "SPARC"),
  "Periportal_hepatocytes"        = c("SAA1", "CRP", "FBP1", "ASS1", "PCK1"),
  "Epithelial_cells"              = c("KRT18", "PTK2", "SIGMAR1", "VPS29", "MED15"),
  "Stressed_midzonal_hepatocytes" = c("HAMP", "FOS", "JUND", "SERPINE1", "CXCL2"),
  "Plasma_cells_1"                = c("IGKC", "IGHG1/2", "JCHAIN", "MZB1", "IGHA1"),
  "IFN_stressed_hepatocytes"      = c("CXCL9", "CXCL10", "STAT1", "HLA-G", "HLA-F"),
  "Plasma_cells_2"                = c("IGLC1/2", "IGLL5", "IGKC", "IGHG1/2", "JCHAIN"),
  "Pericentral_hepatocytes"       = c("GLUL", "TDO2", "FKBP5", "MGST1", "HSD11B1"),
  "Cholangiocytes"                = c("KRT7", "KRT8", "TACSTD2", "MMP7", "SPP1")
)

plots <- lapply(names(jci_insight_markers)[1:2], function(x) {
  message(x)
  p <- FeaturePlot(HCC_qc, features = jci_insight_markers[[x]], order = TRUE, raster = FALSE, combine = FALSE)
  p <- lapply(p, function(x) x + theme(legend.position = "none"))
  patchwork::wrap_plots(p, nrow = 1)
})

patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, nrow = 2)
```
